fields.label: Brand ID
fields.description: (Optional) SendCloud Brand ID used on the shipping label.

fields.label: Return Sender Address ID
fields.description: Numeric id of the SendCloud sender address returns should arrive at. Without it no return label can be bought — there is more than one address on the account and picking one here is a decision, not a default.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Optional override for the webhook signature secret. Leave blank to verify with the API Secret (SendCloud signs webhooks with it). Webhook URL: /api/method/erpnext_shipping.erpnext_shipping.webhook.sendcloud_webhook

fields.label: Only show preferred options when fetching rates
fields.description: When enabled and at least one preferred option is saved, the Fetch Shipping Rates dialog shows only the saved (starred) SendCloud options.

fields.label: Preferred Options
fields.description: Frequently used SendCloud shipping options. Add via the star button in the Fetch Shipping Rates dialog, or edit here. A row that carries a contract ships on that contract without asking.

fields.label: Contracts
fields.description: Press Sync to pull the account's contracts, then give each one a name you recognise. SendCloud returns no name for its own contracts, so a carrier with several of them shows the same label repeatedly and only the id tells them apart.
